result.instructions: Tools for Hiveage, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are overdue or still unpaid, and what is the total outstanding?"; "Show all invoices and estimates for the client Acme Inc."; "Record a $500 bank transfer payment on invoice IN-014.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hiveage data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hiveage_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hiveage_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hiveage_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. hiveage_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hiveage_list_connections
tools.title: List connections
tools.description: List connections: the companies, clients and vendors in the account's network, sorted by name. Each has a hash_key (used by other tools) and a numeric id (used as connection_id when creating invoices). Hiveage: GET /network.

tools.name: hiveage_get_connection
tools.title: Get connection
tools.description: Get one connection (client, vendor or company) by hash_key. Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the connection (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_list_connection_invoices
tools.title: List a connection's invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of one connection (client), by date. Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}/invoices.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the connection (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_list_connection_estimates
tools.title: List a connection's estimates
tools.description: List the estimates of one connection (client). Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}/estimates.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the connection (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_list_connection_recurring_invoices
tools.title: List a connection's recurring invoices
tools.description: List the recurring invoice profiles of one connection (client). Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}/recurring_invoices.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the connection (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts (people with an email address for sending statements) of a connection. Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}/contacts.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the connection (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact of a connection by its numeric id. Hiveage: GET /network/{hash_key}/contacts/{id}.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the connection (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices (state draft, viewed, sent, paid or partial) with totals, sorted by date. Hiveage: GET /invs.

tools.name: hiveage_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by hash_key, with its line items, taxes, discounts and shipping. Hiveage: GET /invs/{hash_key}.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the invoice (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes), sorted by date. Hiveage: GET /estm.

tools.name: hiveage_get_estimate
tools.title: Get estimate
tools.description: Get one estimate by hash_key, with its line items. Hiveage: GET /estm/{hash_key}.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the estimate (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_list_recurring_invoices
tools.title: List recurring invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoice profiles (interval, next billing date, occurrences). Hiveage: GET /rinv.

tools.name: hiveage_get_recurring_invoice
tools.title: Get recurring invoice
tools.description: Get one recurring invoice profile by hash_key. Hiveage: GET /rinv/{hash_key}.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the recurring invoice (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_list_recurring_invoice_invoices
tools.title: List invoices generated by a recurring invoice
tools.description: List the invoices a recurring invoice profile has generated. Hiveage: GET /rinv/{hash_key}/invoices.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the recurring invoice (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

annotations.title: List invoices generated by a recurring invoice

tools.name: hiveage_list_payments
tools.title: List invoice payments
tools.description: List the payments entered on an invoice. Hiveage: GET /invs/{hash_key}/payments.

tools.name: hiveage_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: Get one payment of an invoice by its numeric id. Hiveage: GET /invs/{hash_key}/payments/{id}.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the invoice (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_list_categories
tools.title: List saved items, expense, task or trip categories
tools.description: List the saved line-item templates: kind items (saved items with price and unit), expenses, tasks (with rate) or trips (with rate). Hiveage: GET /categories/{kind}.

annotations.title: List saved items, expense, task or trip categories

tools.name: hiveage_create_connection
tools.title: Create connection
tools.description: WRITE: create a new connection (client, vendor or company) in the account. For an organization give `name`; for an individual give first_name and last_name. Hiveage: POST /network.

category.description: organization (use name) or individual (use first_name and last_name).

currency.description: ISO currency code, for example USD.

language.description: Language code, default en-us (also en-uk, zh, da, nl, de, et, fil, fr, hi, it, ja, ko, ms, pt-br, ru, si, es).

tools.name: hiveage_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact (name and email, used when sending statements) to a connection. Hiveage: POST /network/{hash_key}/contacts.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the connection (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a contact (only the fields you pass are sent). Hiveage: PUT /network/{hash_key}/contacts/{id}.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the connection (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_create_invoice
tools.title: Create invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create an invoice (starts as a draft; nothing is emailed) for a connection. statement_no must be unique. connection_id is the numeric `id` from hiveage_list_connections. Hiveage: POST /invs.

connection_id.description: The numeric id (not the hash_key) of the connection to bill.

statement_no.description: Unique invoice number, for example IN-001.

taxes.description: Taxes added to the sub total.

combined_amount_percent.description: Fixed or percentage value, for example "5.00" or "5.25%".

percentage.description: true if the value is a percentage.

discounts.description: Discounts applied to the sub total.

combined_amount_percent.description: Fixed or percentage value, for example "5.00" or "5.25%".

percentage.description: true if the value is a percentage.

combined_amount_percent.description: Fixed or percentage value, for example "5.00" or "5.25%".

percentage.description: true if the value is a percentage.

tools.name: hiveage_create_estimate
tools.title: Create estimate
tools.description: WRITE: create an estimate (quote; starts as a draft, nothing is emailed) for a connection. statement_no must be unique. Hiveage: POST /estm.

connection_id.description: The numeric id (not the hash_key) of the connection.

statement_no.description: Unique estimate number, for example EST-001.

taxes.description: Taxes added to the sub total.

combined_amount_percent.description: Fixed or percentage value, for example "5.00" or "5.25%".

percentage.description: true if the value is a percentage.

discounts.description: Discounts applied to the sub total.

combined_amount_percent.description: Fixed or percentage value, for example "5.00" or "5.25%".

percentage.description: true if the value is a percentage.

combined_amount_percent.description: Fixed or percentage value, for example "5.00" or "5.25%".

percentage.description: true if the value is a percentage.

tools.name: hiveage_record_payment
tools.title: Record invoice payment
tools.description: WRITE: enter a payment received on an invoice (changes its paid and due totals). Offline payments (cash, check, bank_transfer) are saved as unrealized until marked realized. Hiveage: POST /invs/{hash_key}/payments.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the invoice (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_mark_payment_realized
tools.title: Mark payment realized
tools.description: WRITE: mark an offline (unrealized) payment as realized, so it counts as received. Hiveage: POST /invs/{hash_key}/payments/{id}/mark_as_realized.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the invoice (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

tools.name: hiveage_create_saved_item
tools.title: Create saved item
tools.description: WRITE: save a reusable line item (name, price, unit) for statements. Hiveage: POST /categories/items.

tools.name: hiveage_send_invoice
tools.title: Send invoice by email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL: email an invoice to the client (the default invoice template to the connection's contacts, or a custom recipient/subject/message). Cannot be undone. Hiveage: POST /invs/{hash_key}/deliver.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the invoice (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

confirm.description: Must be true: this emails real people from the Hiveage account.

recipients.description: Custom TO addresses (all of recipients, subject and message are then needed). Omit for the default template and the connection's contacts.

tools.name: hiveage_send_invoice_reminder
tools.title: Send invoice reminder by email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL: email a payment reminder for an invoice (default reminder template, or custom). Cannot be undone. Hiveage: POST /invs/{hash_key}/reminder.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the invoice (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

confirm.description: Must be true: this emails real people from the Hiveage account.

recipients.description: Custom TO addresses (all of recipients, subject and message are then needed). Omit for the default template and the connection's contacts.

tools.name: hiveage_send_estimate
tools.title: Send estimate by email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL: email an estimate to the client (default template, or custom). Cannot be undone. Hiveage: POST /estm/{hash_key}/deliver.

hash_key.description: The hash_key of the estimate (a short string such as "bCbFYNj3RFM2uQ"), not its numeric id.

confirm.description: Must be true: this emails real people from the Hiveage account.

recipients.description: Custom TO addresses (all of recipients, subject and message are then needed). Omit for the default template and the connection's contacts.
